email.subject: Forge Fitness: no booking button on mobile
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Forge Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not usable on mobile (most people search for gyms on their phone), and there's no way to book a class or trial session online, so anyone ready to join has to call during business hours or give up.

I fix local business sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd do? No pitch, just the screen share.

Alex
Northlight Web
